title: IPv4 addresses and subnets
hints: Parse by hand, part by part: read up to three digits, check the value, then expect a dot (or the end, after the fourth part). Building the address as `(value << 8) | part` makes the first part the top byte.
`maskOf(p)` is `~((1u << (32 - p)) - 1)`, but shifting a 32-bit value by 32 is undefined, so handle 0 and 32 separately.
